 Jacob Elordi and Kendall Jenner Discuss Marriage as Their Relationship Grows Serious
 AC Shick 2026년 10월 27일 화 오후 5:56 UTC 0 (Emma McIntyre / Getty Images) Could wedding bells be in the future for Kendall Jenner and Jacob Elordi ? 
 A source told In Touch Weekly that the celebrity couple is looking at taking the next step in their relationship. 
 “Jacob doesn’t really enjoy the single life and when he falls for somebody, he falls hard,” the source told the outlet. “He’s also looking down the barrel of turning 30 next year and he’s ready to settle down.”
 The 30-year-old model and reality star, “is basically in the same place in her life,” the source shared, adding this is “why marriage has been such a heavy topic of conversation between the two of them.” 
 The 29-year-old Academy Award-nominated actor has only been linked to Jenner for a few months, with relationship rumors beginning earlier this year. The source shared that the couple began getting serious soon after dating. 
 Advertisement
 “Jacob used to hate coming to L.A. for work, but she has completely turned him around on the place and he’s actually looking forward to building a future with her there,” the source continued. “Of course, part of that process means accommodating the Kardashian family’s reality TV empire and the intrusive presence of cameras that goes along with it.”
 The source shared that Elordi “handled that part well.” He “has seen what his life can be with a partner like Kendall, and he’s giving every indication that he’s finally found the woman he wants to marry and have kids with!”
 In 2022, Elordi and Jenner were first spotted meeting in Paris. A photo with a group of friends spread on social media . 
 Jenner was reportedly dating Devin Booker at the time, while Elordi was seeing Olivia Jade Giannulli . In April 2026, they sparked romantic rumors after they were seen kissing at Coachella.
